newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador banana exports up 19.7 pct in Jan-Feb.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador banana exports up 19.7 pct in Jan-Feb.

text.p: Ecuador banana exports totalled 719,268 tonnes in January and February, up 19.7 percent from the first two months of 1996, the official National Banana Program (PNB) said Wednesday.
In the first two months of 1996, Ecuador exported 600,652 tonnes of bananas.
PNB added that Ecuador earned $213.3 million from banana exports in the first two months of 1997, up from $143.7 million in the same period of 1996.
Ecuador, the world's top banana exporter, sold 3.84 million tonnes abroad in 1996 and 3.7 million tonnes in 1995.
The European Union was the largest buyer in the two months at 292,863 tonnes valued at $88.4 million, while the United States was the second, at 178,297 tonnes for $53.5 million.
